ios.desc:
Transform your browsing experience with Extension AI, a powerful Safari extension that brings ChatGPT's capabilities right to your fingertips. Whether you select specific text or analyze entire webpages, instantly interact with ChatGPT in multiple ways:

• Ask questions and discuss content directly with ChatGPT
• Fact-check information with sourced verification
• Get concise summaries of long articles
• Receive simple explanations (ELI5 style)
• Extract key points from complex content
• Translate text into multiple languages
• Generate thought-provoking questions

Supports 11 languages including English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. Perfect for students, researchers, professionals, and anyone who wants to enhance their web browsing with AI assistance.

Simple to use: Just select text or let the extension analyze the entire webpage, click the extension icon, choose your desired action, and get instant AI-powered insights.

quotes.text: I was looking for a Safari Extension to quickly leverage chatGPT to fact check, translate or summarize web pages or content, and couldn't find a suitable solution, so I built it. No more copy pasting from one tab to another.
